text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship puts on a fantastic
performance and
comes in first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think having a rival gave her an extra
push to
reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There were laughs, and there were
tears...
Looking back, I definitely took
the long way
round getting here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But despite that, those days were worth
it! They
led me to today's victory!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The romance of the journey... It warms
the heart
like, well, chestnuts roasting
on an open fire!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I lost to her again?! But hooow?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just saying, but this time and last
time were
total flukes, okay?! I'm totally
winning next time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Have something to say to me, do
you?
You've got chestnuts, I'll give you
that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, sure! I'll be waiting for you at
the next
big race! Be there, or be
square!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'll be there all right, and you're
gonna wish
you'd never challenged me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like another showdown with
Tosen Jordan
is in the cards.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now to head off in search of new
chestnuts...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? There's something on the ground
where
Jordan was standing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's see here... A piece of paper with
"RI" on it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Probably. So far I've gotten "UM," then
"QUA,"
and now "RI"...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that doesn't make a lick of sense!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again, our mystery puzzle-giver
has fulfilled
their promise and given us a
new clue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There must be a reason why someone is
doing
this, considering all the effort
that's been put into
it, but I have no
idea what it is. Just then...

Yes! Excellent!  There is no greater
treasure than
a bond formed in the heat
of battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That familiar voice is the same one I
heard before!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The person who wrote the Book of
Secrets and
prepared the clues... I have
a feeling they're
someone we know fairly
well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, Gold Ship has the same
dream again.

"Ship of gold, resting beneath the
waves..."

"Uncharted territory lies just before
you... Now is
the time to unleash your
true potential..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... That dream again, huh? It's getting pretty old at this point...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So sleepy... Maybe practicing the Trinity
Pose will
wake me up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I see you're wastin' time on useless crap,
same as
ever.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey Nakayama. Wanna join m—hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, what's with this sense of déjà vu?
Wait,
Nakayama kinda sounds like the
person in my
dream...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you the one who keeps showing
up in my
dreams?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...The heck?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a question... You take one
too many
hits to the head or something?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A swing and a miss, huh? Never mind.
Forget I
said anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
(I dunno what any of this means, but
something's
telling me Nakayama might
be my next key to
solving this mystery...)
